novelty_basis: Partial - the ETP commentary states that squaring is injective for 704 (reviews/historian_spectra_2026.md, section 6); quasigroup forcing for 704 and 883 was not found in the sources read, but the arguments are two lines long and probably known to ETP contributors.
proof_check: Lean 4 (complete) - law883_right_bijective, law704_square_bijective, law704_right_bijective (proofs/lean/Infinity/C05_QuasigroupLaws.lean, standard axioms only)
statement: In a finite magma satisfying x = y(y((xx)y)) (704), the squaring map x -> xx and every right translation are bijections; in a finite magma satisfying x = y((xy)(yy)) (883), every right translation is a bijection. With the left translations (bijective for every law x = y*T), the Cayley table is a Latin square in both cases.
title: Finite models of the ETP laws 704 and 883 are quasigroups (Lean); for 704 squaring is a bijection
